transcript: Speaker 1 @0.0s [en]: Good morning everyone. Thanks for joining the weekly planning meeting for the mobile app redesign.
Speaker 2 @8.7s [en]: Morning.
Speaker 2 @9.8s [en]: I reviewed the design files yesterday and I have a few concerns about the onboarding flow.
Speaker 1 @16.8s [en]: Okay, let's start there. What is the main problem you noticed?
Speaker 2 @21.1s [en]: The sign up screen asks for too much information up front. Most people will abandon it before they finish.
Speaker 1 @26.0s [en]: That makes sense. Could we move the profile questions to a later step after the first login?
Speaker 2 @32.3s [en]: Yes, I think that would work.
Speaker 2 @35.9s [en]: We would only ask for an email address and a password at the beginning.
Speaker 1 @40.1s [en]: Great.
Speaker 1 @41.1s [en]: Then let's decide that the sign up screen will only collect email and password.
Speaker 2 @46.8s [en]: Agreed.
Speaker 2 @47.8s [en]: I will update the wire frames and share them with the team before Thursday.
Speaker 1 @52.8s [en]: Perfect.
Speaker 1 @53.9s [en]: The next topic is the notification settings. Customers keep asking for a quiet mode during the weekend.
Speaker 2 @60.4s [en]: We could add a simple toggle in the settings page. It should be easy to build.
Speaker 1 @64.0s [en]: I like that idea, but we need to check with the back end team about scheduling.
Speaker 2 @68.8s [en]: I can talk to Omar about it this afternoon and I will report back tomorrow.
Speaker 1 @74.6s [en]: Thank you.
Speaker 1 @75.7s [en]: Another item is the performance of the dashboard.
Speaker 1 @90.0s [en]: It still takes several seconds to load on older phones.
Speaker 2 @96.3s [en]: I measured it last week. Most of the delay comes from loading every chart at the same time.
Speaker 1 @101.9s [en]: So should we load the charts only when the user scrolls to them?
Speaker 2 @107.2s [en]: Exactly. Lazy loading should cut the waiting time roughly in half.
Speaker 1 @112.3s [en]: All right. Let's make lazy loading the priority for the next sprint.
Speaker 2 @118.2s [en]: Sounds good.
Speaker 2 @119.4s [en]: Should we also invite the support team to the next review?
Speaker 1 @124.2s [en]: Yes, please send them an invitation.
Speaker 1 @127.0s [en]: Their feedback about customer complaints would be really helpful.
Speaker 2 @132.1s [en]: Will do.
Speaker 2 @133.1s [en]: Is there anything else we need to cover today?
Speaker 1 @137.0s [en]: I think that is everything.
Speaker 1 @139.0s [en]: Thanks everyone, and see you next week.

direct.summary: The meeting focused on the mobile app redesign, addressing concerns about the onboarding flow, notification settings, and dashboard performance. A key decision was made to simplify the sign-up process by only collecting email and password initially. The team also discussed adding a quiet mode for notifications and implementing lazy loading for the dashboard to improve performance. S2 committed to updating wireframes, consulting with the backend team, and inviting the support team to the next review.
decisions: confirmed: The sign-up screen will only collect email and password initially, with profile questions moved to a later step after the first login.
confirmed: Lazy loading will be implemented for the dashboard charts to improve performance and will be prioritized for the next sprint.

direct.summary: عقد اجتماع لمراجعة تكامل Visma. تم الانتهاء من توثيق الـ API ومشاركته مع الفريق. لوحظ بطء في أداء النظام في بيئة الإنتاج، وتم تحديد أن السبب هو استعلامات قاعدة البيانات غير المحسّنة في صفحة التقارير. تقرر إضافة التخزين المؤقت (caching) لنقطة نهاية التقارير قبل نهاية الأسبوع. كما تم مناقشة طلب شركة لديمو للنظام الجديد الأحد القادم، وسيتم دعوة فريق الدعم لحضوره. أخيرًا، سيتم إجراء الاختبارات النهائية على Supabase غدًا صباحًا.
